body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: Conciseness: The 11-line nested conditional spread is over-engineered. A single-line ternary achieves the same acceptance criteria with fewer lines: `live_preview: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST ? { enable: true, host: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST, ...(CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN ? { management_token: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN } : {}) } : { enable: false },`. The implementation conditionally spreads the entire `live_preview` object and then nests another conditional spread inside it — two layers of conditional spreading where one ternary suffices. Note: the prescribed fix used `preview_token` but dependency_contract confirms that key is 'absent' from the contentstack SDK (v3.17.2) — `management_token` is the correct consumed key, so the one-liner above uses `management_token`.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace lines 62-72 with: `live_preview: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST ? { enable: true, host: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST, ...(CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN ? { management_token: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN } : {}) } : { enable: false },`

issues.description: The else branch sets `management_token: ""` (empty string) when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN is unset. The dependency_contract confirms `management_token` is 'consumed' by the SDK runtime — passing an empty string may cause the SDK to attempt preview authentication with an empty token, potentially causing silent failures or errors. The prescribed fix pattern omits the key entirely via `...(CONDITION ? { key: value } : {})` when no token is available, letting the SDK fall back to its default behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the `: { management_token: "" }` else branch. Use `...(CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN ? { management_token: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN } : {})` so the key is absent when no token is set.

issues.description: Missing test coverage for live_preview configuration. The existing test file has tests for CONTENTSTACK_FETCH_TIMEOUT (lines ~120-140) but no test cases for the live_preview config — e.g., verifying that options.live_preview is correct when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is set with/without a token, and absent/disabled when unset. Searched for 'live_preview' and 'preview' in the test file; no matching `it(`/`test(` block found. The diff modifies a configuration path that has no corresponding test.
issues.suggestedFix: Add test cases to src/services/__tests__/contentstack.spec.ts mirroring the existing CONTENTSTACK_FETCH_TIMEOUT tests: (1) when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is set, options.live_preview.enable is true and host matches; (2) when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is set with CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, options.live_preview.management_token equals the token; (3) when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is unset, live_preview is disabled or absent.

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: PRESCRIBED ROOT CAUSE NOT ADDRESSED. The root cause analysis explicitly requires integrating @contentstack/live-preview-utils inside ContentstackProvider: import ContentstackLivePreview, call ContentstackLivePreview.init() at module level, and replace the static useMemo with useState + useEffect subscribing to onEntryChange callbacks. The diff adds only a passive IContentstackLivePreview interface and a livePreview field on the context shape — zero SDK import, zero init(), zero useState/useEffect subscription, zero onEntryChange wiring. No component in the codebase actually receives or reacts to CMS preview updates. Every acceptance criterion (unchanged fields display correctly, malformed updates don't break, non-preview sessions work, post-exit values correct) depends on the SDK integration existing; without it, none can be satisfied at runtime.
issues.suggestedFix: Implement the prescribed minimal fix: (1) import ContentstackLivePreview from '@contentstack/live-preview-utils'; (2) call ContentstackLivePreview.init() at module level (or inside the provider with a guard); (3) in ContentstackProvider, replace the static useMemo that builds the context value with useState(initialContent=defaultContent) + useEffect that calls ContentstackLivePreview.onEntryChange(({ entry }) => setState(prev => mergeEntry(prev, entry))). The existing defaultContent prop becomes the initial state. Remove the unused IContentstackLivePreview.setLivePreview callback field — the SDK callback is the update mechanism, not a manual setter.

issues.description: TESTS DO NOT VERIFY ANY ACCEPTANCE CRITERION AT RUNTIME. Every test creates plain TypeScript objects and asserts field values — they verify that interfaces can hold data, not that live preview works. None of the 4 verification criteria (unchanged fields display correctly during preview, malformed updates don't break rendering, non-preview sessions show complete content, post-exit values correct) are tested because there is no provider, no rendering, no SDK callback, and no state update being exercised. The test file is 179 lines of shape assertions that would pass even if live preview is entirely unimplemented — which it is.
issues.suggestedFix: After implementing the actual SDK integration in ContentstackProvider, write tests that: (1) render the provider with defaultContent and a child consuming useContent; (2) simulate an onEntryChange callback firing with updated entry data and assert the child re-renders with new values; (3) simulate a malformed/empty entry update and assert the child still renders previous content without error; (4) render without any preview session and assert all content is present; (5) simulate exiting preview (callback fires with null/clear) and assert content reverts to defaults. Use @testing-library/react renderHook or render.

issues.description: Multiple untyped `as any` casts without explanatory comments violate TypeScript strict compliance: `basePage as any` appears on lines 35, 55, 82, 107, 131, 155, and `[{}] as [any]` on lines 81-82. The basePage object should be typed as IContentstackPage (or a partial cast with a comment explaining why).
issues.suggestedFix: Type basePage as `Partial<IContentstackPage> as IContentstackPage` or construct a minimal valid IContentstackPage. Add explanatory comments for any remaining `as any` casts, or eliminate them entirely.

issues.description: IContentstackLivePreview.setLivePreview callback field is dead code. No component sets this callback, no consumer invokes it in production code, and the SDK's onEntryChange is the prescribed update mechanism. Including it in the interface suggests a manual-update pattern that contradicts the prescribed SDK-driven approach.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove setLivePreview from IContentstackLivePreview. The SDK callback handles state updates internally inside the provider; consumers should never need to manually set preview state.

issues.description: IContentCardLivePreview and the live_preview field on IContentCard are added but never consumed by any component or hook. ContentstackLink.tsx and useContent.ts (listed as relevant files) show no changes. Without the SDK integration merging incoming entry data into the content state, these metadata fields serve no purpose — they are never read, never populated by a callback, and never affect rendering.
issues.suggestedFix: These fields become meaningful only after the SDK integration is implemented. If the SDK's onEntryChange delivers full entry objects (which already include live_preview metadata from Contentstack), this manual interface may be unnecessary. Verify whether Contentstack entries already carry live_preview; if so, remove the hand-rolled interface and rely on the SDK-provided shape.
